test_title: PYST 24 - SSC CHSL 2025 - General Intelligence (Held On: 21 Nov, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: 6 persons A, B, C, D, E and F are sitting in a row facing north (not necessarily in the same order). E is to the immediate left of B. C is the immediate neighbour of A and E. Some persons are to the right of F. D is not at any of the end of the row. Who is sitting second to the right of F?
solution:
Given: 6 persons.

F is not at the right end. D is not at any end.

From clues, E is immediate left of B, and C is immediate Neighbour of both A and E 

Remaining D and F go to the left 

So, 2nd to the right of F = **A**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f847060a7c84c664f52c15b32d3f24d98d58d465cce5331114e087a36647e3d.png] 

So, the person sitting second to the right of F is **'A'**.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
